title: Beyond the Vacuum: Combinatorial Strategy Selection for Competitor-Aware Generative Engine Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.27631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) has emerged as a novel paradigm for transforming content to increase visibility in Large Language Model (LLM) responses. Traditional GEO methods, however, select rewriting strategies in isolation, ignoring a critical externality: as adoption of content optimization grows, optimal strategies for rewriting content change. We formalize GEO as a competitor-aware strategy selection problem and propose a two-phase pipeline to solve it: (1) We use Bayesian Optimization of Combinatorial Structures (BOCS) to efficiently search the space of rewriting strategies, (2) We generate preference pairs and grounded reasoning traces from the BOCS black-box observations to fine-tune a language model to analyze a document corpus and propose optimal rewriting strategy combinations. We achieve state-of-the-art performance across several impression metrics over existing agentic and single-heuristic methods on both geo-bench

translated_title: 超越真空：面向竞争者感知的生成式引擎优化的组合策略选择
translated_abstract: 生成式引擎优化已成为一种新兴范式，通过转换内容来提高其在大型语言模型（LLM）回答中的可见度。然而，传统的GEO方法在孤立状态下选择重写策略，忽略了一个关键的外部性：随着内容优化技术的普及，最优的内容重写策略也会随之改变。我们将GEO形式化为一个竞争者感知的策略选择问题，并提出一个两阶段流水线来解决它：（1）我们使用组合结构的贝叶斯优化（BOCS）来高效搜索重写策略空间；（2）我们从BOCS的黑盒观测中生成偏好对和有据推理轨迹，以微调一个语言模型，使其能够分析文档语料库并提出最优的重写策略组合。在geo-bench上，我们在多个印象指标上超越了现有的代理式和单一启发式方法，取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 该论文将生成式引擎优化形式化为竞争者感知的策略选择问题，提出用组合结构贝叶斯优化搜索最优重写策略，并利用其观测数据微调语言模型来推荐策略组合，在竞争环境下实现了最先进的可见度提升效果。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes Generative Engine Optimization as a competitor-aware strategy selection problem, proposing a two-phase pipeline that uses Bayesian Optimization of Combinatorial Structures to search rewriting strategies and fine-tunes a language model on its observations to recommend optimal strategy combinations, achieving state-of-the-art visibility performance.
